description:
Step 2 of fz-t93.7. Iface(root,E)/Body(root,E) facts; deletes the TransportShape product family (30,289 requests, 60% of pull cost), the cut_in_component_returns product path and the local callable-construction round-trip. Predicted -0.5% (-3.1..+1.3); jobs +3..5k; requests -30.3k. Risks: the interface acyclicity claim (36 executable SCCs, 0 interface edges, spike-verified on an older base); Body reads per position; a same-root product wait until step 3. Bar: distiller instructions within the stated prediction; stdout byte-identical; fixture_matrix green; every pin that rises is listed with its mechanism and reported for approval before it is raised. Measured base e81f9ed52 and the per-step model: scratch t93_7/m/report.md; decision page /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-t93.7-measured.html.

Pulled forward (user, 2026-11-24, "proceed" on JSON's fz-mue.25 page /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-mue.25.html): this ticket fixes fz-mue.25. fz-engine builds it ahead of fz-t93.28's build and fz-t93.30. First step: re-run the interface-acyclicity census on current develop, on the distiller and on fz-mue.25's json repro (/Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-752-walk/repro_25.fz), because 9zq.2's cycle entries, .12/.16, .17, #851 and t93.26 changed which executables exist since e81f9ed52. If interface edges now cycle, a cut rule and a new page come first. json repro today: 55,555 requests, 47,215 (85%) on TransportShape over 37,557 keys; one product drive hits the 50,000 cap (product_drive.rs:31). Re-measure the -30.3k requests / -0.5% instructions prediction.

Acyclicity census (fz-engine, 2026-11-24, scratch t93_72/): interface edges are acyclic only because of the existing cut (jobs/transport.rs ~2209). Without it: distiller 32 interface SCCs, repro_25 15 (up to 37 executables), 00420 7; with it, 0 everywhere. So the Iface fact carries the same cut, reading ExecutableReach per foreign Return, and the cut must follow typed origin, not mint order (added to fz-t93.28's build; this ticket stacks on .28). CallableConstruction reads foreign Value positions, outside the Iface/Body split (fz-t93.7.5's problem). Input->Input edges have no cut and rely on capture ordering; acyclic as observed, guarded by a debug assertion. Cost model: about 2k Iface reads replace ~22.6k transport reads on the distiller, plus at least 2,220 fact jobs.
